Vision Government Solutions

|

Coventry, CT

|

Welcome

Welcome to the Vision Government Solutions Assessment Record database for the Town of Coventry.

As mandated by Connecticut State Law, the Town of Coventry and Vision Government Solutions are completing a revaluation of all real property for the Grand List of October 1, 2024.

Shown on this site are assessments of all taxable and exempt properties based on 70% of market value as of October 1, 2024. The previous assessments were as of October 1, 2019.

Please note that assessed values do not reflect any exemptions, which will be applied to the final assessments.

Notices were sent out to property owners on December 5, 2024, informing them of their new assessments. The new assessment represents 70% of the fair market value as of the October 1, 2024, assessment date.

Important: Please do not use the current mill rate to estimate your taxes. A new mill rate will be established once the grand list is finalized and the budget completed in the Spring of 2025. It is anticipated that the mill rate will decrease with the significant increase in RE values.

More information regarding the revaluation and assessment process can be found at:

Taxpayer Revaluation Link [https://www.vgsi.com/taxpayer-revaluation-information/]

The Coventry Assessor’s Office and Vision Government Solutions would like to thank the residents and property owners for their cooperation throughout the 2024 Revaluation project.

(c) 2026 Vision Government Solutions, Inc. All rights reserved.
